visual.general_description: Close-up color photograph of the lower face with full, rounded upper and lower lips.
visual.detailed_description: Close-up color photograph of the lower part of a face, tilted so the mouth runs diagonally across the frame. A black covering crosses the upper left corner. The nose with both nostrils is at the top, the lips fill the center, and stubbled skin of the chin and cheeks surrounds them. Both the upper and lower lips look full and rounded; the lower lip is reddish pink with a glossy white highlight along its center. Blue fabric is at the upper right and white sheet or pillow areas fill the right edge and bottom. No text, arrows, scale bar or panel letters are visible.
